_comment: LoopStar synth drum kits (Phase SD). CONTENT -- the DSP lives in LoopStarDrumSynth.swift, these are just knob positions, so a new kit ships with zero rebuild (RULE #1). The binary carries ONE neutral fallback for offline first launch; everything below is authoritative. Knobs: tune = kick landing pitch in Hz; decay = kick ring in seconds (the trap boom); snap = pitch-drop + attack click; drive = kit saturation; tone = dark/tonal .. bright/noisy for snare+hats; hatDecay = closed-hat length in seconds; level = kit trim.

presets.name: Trap 808
presets.blurb: Long tuned sub that rings under the bar -- the sound the genre is built on

presets.name: Rap Knock
presets.blurb: Short, hard, punchy -- gets out of the way of the vocal

presets.name: Boom Bap
presets.blurb: Fat dusty kick and a wide cracking snare

presets.name: Pop Punch
presets.blurb: Clean, tight and bright -- sits in a dense mix

presets.name: Deep Sub
presets.blurb: Almost no click -- felt rather than heard

presets.name: Hard 909
presets.blurb: Driven techno kick with bright noisy hats
